reason: B is preferable because it specifies a genuinely blinded prospective test, experimentally measured heterostructure descriptors, explicit property-error thresholds, and quantified efficiency gains under a defined calibration regime. Both proposals leave their numerical gains weakly supported and inadequately benchmarked against a named baseline, but A’s non-blinded test and rule requiring failure in more than 80% of samples make its falsification criterion substantially less decisive.
